dataset.countDefinition: Every distinct truck body visible in the camera image, including trailer-only when clearly separate; forklifts, cars, vans and people excluded. A tractor and its trailer count once.
reviewNotes: south_5: the far brown cargo body may be a trailer of the middle truck; counted as separate only because the two cargo bodies and cabs are spatially distinct.
All south frames: bottom-edge red cargo body may belong to the adjacent aisle rather than the counted corridor; corridor polygon must be confirmed by the user.
Boxes are not yet part of this gold file; do not report box IoU against it.
